
```{r}
lvl <- c(
  "CD4 TN",
  "CD4 TSM",
  "CD4 TH1DM",
  "CD4 Regulatory",
  "CD8 TN",
  "CD8 TSM",
  "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM",
  "DN TSM",
  "Proliferating"
  )

lab <- c(
  "CD4 TN"            = expression("CD4 TN"),
  "CD4 TSM"           = expression("CD4 TSM"),
  "CD4 TH1DM"         = expression("CD4 " * T[H1] * DM),
  "CD4 TCTLDM"        = expression("CD4 " * T[CTL] * DM),
  "CD4 Regulatory"    = expression("CD4 " * T[reg]),
  "CD8 TN"              = expression("CD8 TN"),
  "CD8 TSM"             = expression("CD8 TSM"),
  "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM"       = expression("CD8 " * T[c1*"-"*CTL] * DM),
  "DN TSM"           = expression("DN TSM"),
  "Proliferating"  = expression("Proliferating"))

```

#-----Changes in Representation------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- Tc@meta.data  %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue, celltype) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(Tissue) %>%                      # within each celltype
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()


Percent <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Tissue, y = percent, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  labs(y = "Percent of cells",
       fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 2,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.title = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()   # remove x-axis title
  ) + scale_fill_manual(values = cols$celltype_m[levels(Tc)]) + NoLegend()

Percent
```

#-----Venn of DEG------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Spleen <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Spleen", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Spleen <- subset(Spleen, p_val_adj < 0.05)
Stable <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Stable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Stable <- subset(Stable, p_val_adj < 0.05)
Unstable <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Unstable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Unstable <- subset(Unstable, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
Venn <- list(
Spleen = rownames(Spleen),
Stable = rownames(Stable),
Unstable = rownames(Unstable))

svglite("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Venn.svg", width = 4, height = 4)
ggvenn::ggvenn(Venn, fill_color = c("grey", "#00C7CC", "#FA7F74"), show_percentage = F, text_size = txt_pt-2, set_name_size = txt_pt) & theme(text = element_text(family = "Times"))
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Venn.svg")
```

## HM
```{r, fig.height=18, fig.width=2.5, dpi = 300}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Tc.Avg <- AverageExpression(Tc, assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Heatmap_Genes <- Unique_vs_Common_Graph %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(100, wt = avg_log2FC)
Heatmap_Genes$Num <- rownames(Heatmap_Genes)

mtx <- Tc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data
mtx <- as.data.frame(mtx)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(Tc.Avg)
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(Tc.Avg)
         
mtx_sub <-subset(mtx, rownames(mtx) %in% Heatmap_Genes$gene)
x <- Heatmap_Genes$gene
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, c(3,2,1)]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

meta <- Tc.Avg@meta.data
meta$cluster <- rownames(meta)
meta <- meta[c(3,2,1),]

# Set up annotations for rows and clusters
# genes you want to label
genes_to_label <- c(
  "Tcf7", "Sell", "Lef1", "Cd27",
  "Klrg1", "Il7r", "Stat4", "Itga4",
  "Tnf", "Klrk1", "Ly6e", "Il18r", "Nrp1", "Jak2",
  "Gzmb", "Cd44", "Cd69", "Pdcd1", "Bhlhe40", "Icos", "Cxcr6", "Pdcd1", "Il18r", "Tnfrsf4", "Furin", "Fth1", "Gpx1"
  
)   # <-- edit this

# find their row indices in the heatmap data
lab_idx <- which(Heatmap_Genes$gene %in% genes_to_label)

# sanity check (optional)
Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx]

labels <- rowAnnotation(
  x = anno_mark(
    at = lab_idx,
    labels_rot = -30,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
    padding = unit(1, "mm"),
    labels = Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx],
    side = "left"
  )
)

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 5,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0)),
  col = list(cluster = cols$Tissue[c(1,3,4)]
)
)

# Set up heatmap colors and legend
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.75, 0, 0.75), c("blue", "#EEEEEE", "red"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
  labels_rot = -90,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

# Create row annotations using HeatmapAnnotation
right_annotation = rowAnnotation(anno = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = cols$Tissue[c(1,3,4,5)]),
        labels = c("Spleen Unique", "Stable Unique", "Unstable Unique", "Plaque Common"), labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = txt_pt), labels_rot = -90))

# Draw heatmap
Hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub)*unit(0.3, "mm"),
  width = ncol(mtx_sub)*unit(3.5, "mm"),
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = cluster_anno,
  right_annotation = right_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  left_annotation = labels,
  col = col_fun,
  split = Heatmap_Genes$cluster,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_names_side = NULL,
  row_title = " ",
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params)

svglite("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Tissue_Hm.svg", width = 3, height = 7)
draw(Hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Tissue_Hm.svg")

```

#-----Cluster Specific Plaque vs. Blood------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "celltype"
Tc <- subset(Tc, idents = c("Proliferating"), invert = T)
table(Tc$celltype)
```
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"
groups <-  levels(Tc)

# Store results
deg_results <- list()

for (g in groups) {
  message("Running DEG for: ", g)
  
  # Subset cells of this TRDV group
  Tc_sub <- subset(Tc, idents = g)
  Idents(Tc_sub) <- "PB"   # Tissue must contain Plaque/Blood
  
  # Run DEG (Plaque vs Blood)
  deg <- FindMarkers(
    Tc_sub,
    ident.1 = "Plaque",
    ident.2 = "Spleen",
    min.pct = 0.2,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    test.use = "MAST",
    only.pos = F
  )
  
  # Add cluster info and gene names
  deg$cluster <- ifelse(deg$avg_log2FC > 0, "Plaque", "Spleen")
  deg$gene <- rownames(deg)
  deg <- subset(deg, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  
  # Save to list
  deg_results[[g]] <- deg
}

# Optionally combine into one big table
all_deg_PB_list <- deg_results
all_deg_PB <- bind_rows(deg_results, .id = "celltype")
rownames(all_deg_PB_list) <- NULL
deg_results <- NULL

counts_plot_PB <- count_and_plot_deg_lollipop(
  deg_list        = all_deg_PB_list,
  contrast_levels = c("Plaque","Spleen"),
  pval_col        = "p_val_adj",
  lfc_col         = "avg_log2FC",
  alpha           = 0.05,
  lfc_thresh      = 0.25,
  font_family = "Times",
  txt_pt = 10,
  pt_size = 4,
  aspect = NULL,
  palette = cols$Tissue,
) + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times", size = txt_pt)) + scale_y_discrete(limits = lvl[1:8], labels = lab)

counts_plot_PB
```

```{r}
plot_genes <- list(
`Plaque vs. Blood` = c("Ldha", "Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Mcl1", "Slc2a3",
"Slc38a2", "Slc3a2", "Slc7a5", "Stat4", "Adgre5",
"Areg", "Arf4", "Icos", "Bhlhe40", "Ccl4", "Ccl5",
"Cd44", "Cd55", "Cd96", "Cxcr4", "Crem", "Cxcr3",
"Cxcr6", "Fth1", "Id2", "Ifngr1", "Ifng", "Il21r",
"Il2rb", "Klf6", "Nr3c1", "Gzma", "Stat3", "Stat4", "Tnf"))

deg_plot <- subset(all_deg_PB, cluster == "Plaque")
deg_plot$regulation <- deg_plot$cluster
deg_plot$cluster <- NULL

plot_levels <- c(lvl)

gene_counts <- deg_plot |>
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "n")

deg_plot$celltype <- factor(deg_plot$celltype, levels = rev(plot_levels))

Plaque_Blood_Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(
  seu = NULL,
    markers_df = deg_plot,
    markers_gene_col  = "gene",
    markers_group_col = "celltype",
    markers_lfc_col   = "avg_log2FC",
    markers_padj_col  = "p_val_adj",
    gene_sets = plot_genes,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "cluster",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,  # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    show_missing = T,
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 10),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(5, 25, 50),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 100),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1.5, 1.5),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = viridisLite::viridis(5),
    x_label      = "",
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = 15,
    y_text_size  = 15,
    x_title_size = 15,
    bracket_text_size = 7.5,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.40,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = FALSE,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclust
    cluster_genes  = c("none","within_group","global"),
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") + theme(text = element_text(family = "Times")) + scale_y_discrete(limits = lvl[1:8], labels = lab)

Plaque_Blood_Dot
```
